domicile.title: Domicile
domicile.description: 2 letter ISO country code for the country where the ETP is domiciled.

fund_listing_date.title: Fund Listing Date
fund_listing_date.description: The date on which the Exchange Traded Product (ETP) or share class of the ETP is listed on a specific exchange.

data_change_date.title: Data Change Date
data_change_date.description: The last date on which there was a change in a classifications data field for this ETF.

etn_maturity_date.title: Etn Maturity Date
etn_maturity_date.description: If the product is an ETN, this field identifies the maturity date for the ETN.

is_listed.title: Is Listed
is_listed.description: If true, the ETF is still listed on an exchange.

close_date.title: Close Date
close_date.description: The date on which the ETF was de-listed if it is no longer listed.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: The exchange Market Identifier Code (MIC).

firstbridge_id.title: Firstbridge Id
firstbridge_id.description: The FirstBridge unique identifier for the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF).

firstbridge_parent_id.title: Firstbridge Parent Id
firstbridge_parent_id.description: The FirstBridge unique identifier for the parent Exchange Traded Fund (ETF), if applicable.

intrinio_id.title: Intrinio Id
intrinio_id.description: Intrinio unique identifier for the security.

primary_symbol.title: Primary Symbol
primary_symbol.description: The primary ticker field is used for Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) that have multiple listings and share classes. If an ETP has multiple listings or share classes, the same primary ticker is assigned to all the listings and share classes.

etp_structure_type.title: Etp Structure Type
etp_structure_type.description: Classifies Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) into very broad categories based on its legal structure.

etn_issuing_bank.title: Etn Issuing Bank
etn_issuing_bank.description: If the product is an Exchange Traded Note (ETN), this field identifies the issuing bank.

fund_family.title: Fund Family
fund_family.description: This field identifies the fund family to which the ETF belongs, as categorized by the ETF Sponsor.

derivatives_based.title: Derivatives Based
derivatives_based.description: This field is populated if the ETF holds either listed or over-the-counter derivatives in its portfolio.

income_category.title: Income Category
income_category.description: Identifies if an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) falls into a category that is specifically designed to provide a high yield or income

asset_class.title: Asset Class
asset_class.description: Captures the underlying nature of the securities in the Exchanged Traded Product (ETP).

other_asset_types.title: Other Asset Types
other_asset_types.description: If 'asset_class' field is classified as 'Other Asset Types' this field captures the specific category of the underlying assets.

single_category_designation.title: Single Category Designation
single_category_designation.description: This categorization is created for those users who want every ETF to be 'forced' into a single bucket, so that the assets for all categories will always sum to the total market.

beta_type.title: Beta Type
beta_type.description: This field identifies whether an ETF provides 'Traditional' beta exposure or 'Smart' beta exposure. ETFs that are active (i.e. non-indexed), leveraged / inverse or have a proprietary quant model (i.e. that don't provide indexed exposure to a targeted factor) are classified separately.

beta_details.title: Beta Details
beta_details.description: This field provides further detail within the traditional and smart beta categories.

market_cap_range.title: Market Cap Range
market_cap_range.description: Equity ETFs are classified as falling into categories based on the description of their investment strategy in the prospectus. Examples ('Mega Cap', 'Large Cap', 'Mid Cap', etc.)

market_cap_weighting_type.title: Market Cap Weighting Type
market_cap_weighting_type.description: For ETFs that take the value 'Market Cap Weighted' in the 'index_weighting_scheme' field, this field provides detail on the market cap weighting type.

index_weighting_scheme.title: Index Weighting Scheme
index_weighting_scheme.description: For ETFs that track an underlying index, this field provides detail on the index weighting type.

index_linked.title: Index Linked
index_linked.description: This field identifies whether an ETF is index linked or active.

index_name.title: Index Name
index_name.description: This field identifies the name of the underlying index tracked by the ETF, if applicable.

index_symbol.title: Index Symbol
index_symbol.description: This field identifies the OpenFIGI ticker for the Index underlying the ETF.

parent_index.title: Parent Index
parent_index.description: This field identifies the name of the parent index, which represents the broader universe from which the index underlying the ETF is created, if applicable.

index_family.title: Index Family
index_family.description: This field identifies the index family to which the index underlying the ETF belongs. The index family is represented as categorized by the index provider.

broader_index_family.title: Broader Index Family
broader_index_family.description: This field identifies the broader index family to which the index underlying the ETF belongs. The broader index family is represented as categorized by the index provider.

index_provider.title: Index Provider
index_provider.description: This field identifies the Index provider for the index underlying the ETF, if applicable.

index_provider_code.title: Index Provider Code
index_provider_code.description: This field provides the First Bridge code for each Index provider, corresponding to the index underlying the ETF if applicable.

replication_structure.title: Replication Structure
replication_structure.description: The replication structure of the Exchange Traded Product (ETP).

growth_value_tilt.title: Growth Value Tilt
growth_value_tilt.description: Classifies equity ETFs as either 'Growth' or Value' based on the stated style tilt in the ETF prospectus. Equity ETFs that do not have a stated style tilt are classified as 'Core / Blend'.

growth_type.title: Growth Type
growth_type.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Growth' in 'growth_value_tilt', this field further identifies those where the stocks in the ETF are both selected and weighted based on their growth (style factor) scores.

value_type.title: Value Type
value_type.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Value' in 'growth_value_tilt', this field further identifies those where the stocks in the ETF are both selected and weighted based on their value (style factor) scores.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: For equity ETFs that aim to provide targeted exposure to a sector or industry, this field identifies the Sector that it provides the exposure to.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: For equity ETFs that aim to provide targeted exposure to an industry, this field identifies the Industry that it provides the exposure to.

industry_group.title: Industry Group
industry_group.description: For equity ETFs that aim to provide targeted exposure to a sub-industry, this field identifies the sub-Industry that it provides the exposure to.

cross_sector_theme.title: Cross Sector Theme
cross_sector_theme.description: For equity ETFs that aim to provide targeted exposure to a specific investment theme that cuts across GICS sectors, this field identifies the specific cross-sector theme. Examples ('Agri-business', 'Natural Resources', 'Green Investing', etc.)

natural_resources_type.title: Natural Resources Type
natural_resources_type.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Natural Resources' in the 'cross_sector_theme' field, this field provides further detail on the type of Natural Resources exposure.

us_or_excludes_us.title: Us Or Excludes Us
us_or_excludes_us.description: Takes the value of 'Domestic' for US exposure, 'International' for non-US exposure and 'Global' for exposure that includes all regions including the US.

developed_emerging.title: Developed Emerging
developed_emerging.description: This field identifies the stage of development of the markets that the ETF provides exposure to.

specialized_region.title: Specialized Region
specialized_region.description: This field is populated if the ETF provides targeted exposure to a specific type of geography-based grouping that does not fall into a specific country or continent grouping. Examples ('BRIC', 'Chindia', etc.)

continent.title: Continent
continent.description: This field is populated if the ETF provides targeted exposure to a specific continent or country within that Continent.

latin_america_sub_group.title: Latin America Sub Group
latin_america_sub_group.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Latin America' in the 'continent' field, this field provides further detail on the type of regional exposure.

europe_sub_group.title: Europe Sub Group
europe_sub_group.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Europe' in the 'continent' field, this field provides further detail on the type of regional exposure.

asia_sub_group.title: Asia Sub Group
asia_sub_group.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'Asia' in the 'continent' field, this field provides further detail on the type of regional exposure.

specific_country.title: Specific Country
specific_country.description: This field is populated if the ETF provides targeted exposure to a specific country.

china_listing_location.title: China Listing Location
china_listing_location.description: For ETFs that are classified as 'China' in the 'country' field, this field provides further detail on the type of exposure in the underlying securities.

us_state.title: Us State
us_state.description: Takes the value of a US state if the ETF provides targeted exposure to the municipal bonds or equities of companies.

real_estate.title: Real Estate
real_estate.description: For ETFs that provide targeted real estate exposure, this field is populated if the ETF provides targeted exposure to a specific segment of the real estate market.

fundamental_weighting_type.title: Fundamental Weighting Type
fundamental_weighting_type.description: For ETFs that take the value 'Fundamental Weighted' in the 'index_weighting_scheme' field, this field provides detail on the fundamental weighting methodology.

dividend_weighting_type.title: Dividend Weighting Type
dividend_weighting_type.description: For ETFs that take the value 'Dividend Weighted' in the 'index_weighting_scheme' field, this field provides detail on the dividend weighting methodology.

bond_type.title: Bond Type
bond_type.description: For ETFs where 'asset_class_type' is 'Bonds', this field provides detail on the type of bonds held in the ETF.

government_bond_types.title: Government Bond Types
government_bond_types.description: For bond ETFs that take the value 'Treasury & Government' in 'bond_type', this field provides detail on the exposure.

municipal_bond_region.title: Municipal Bond Region
municipal_bond_region.description: For bond ETFs that take the value 'Municipal' in 'bond_type', this field provides additional detail on the geographic exposure.

municipal_vrdo.title: Municipal Vrdo
municipal_vrdo.description: For bond ETFs that take the value 'Municipal' in 'bond_type', this field identifies those ETFs that specifically provide exposure to Variable Rate Demand Obligations.

mortgage_bond_types.title: Mortgage Bond Types
mortgage_bond_types.description: For bond ETFs that take the value 'Mortgage' in 'bond_type', this field provides additional detail on the type of underlying securities.

bond_tax_status.title: Bond Tax Status
bond_tax_status.description: For all US bond ETFs, this field provides additional detail on the tax treatment of the underlying securities.

credit_quality.title: Credit Quality
credit_quality.description: For all bond ETFs, this field helps to identify if the ETF provides targeted exposure to securities of a specific credit quality range.

average_maturity.title: Average Maturity
average_maturity.description: For all bond ETFs, this field helps to identify if the ETF provides targeted exposure to securities of a specific maturity range.

specific_maturity_year.title: Specific Maturity Year
specific_maturity_year.description: For all bond ETFs that take the value 'Specific Maturity Year' in the 'average_maturity' field, this field specifies the calendar year.

commodity_types.title: Commodity Types
commodity_types.description: For ETFs where 'asset_class_type' is 'Commodities', this field provides detail on the type of commodities held in the ETF.

energy_type.title: Energy Type
energy_type.description: For ETFs where 'commodity_type' is 'Energy', this field provides detail on the type of energy exposure provided by the ETF.

agricultural_type.title: Agricultural Type
agricultural_type.description: For ETFs where 'commodity_type' is 'Agricultural', this field provides detail on the type of agricultural exposure provided by the ETF.

livestock_type.title: Livestock Type
livestock_type.description: For ETFs where 'commodity_type' is 'Livestock', this field provides detail on the type of livestock exposure provided by the ETF.

metal_type.title: Metal Type
metal_type.description: For ETFs where 'commodity_type' is 'Gold & Metals', this field provides detail on the type of exposure provided by the ETF.

inverse_leveraged.title: Inverse Leveraged
inverse_leveraged.description: This field is populated if the ETF provides inverse or leveraged exposure.

target_date_multi_asset_type.title: Target Date Multi Asset Type
target_date_multi_asset_type.description: For ETFs where 'asset_class_type' is 'Target Date / MultiAsset', this field provides detail on the type of commodities held in the ETF.

currency_pair.title: Currency Pair
currency_pair.description: This field is populated if the ETF's strategy involves providing exposure to the movements of a currency or involves hedging currency exposure.

social_environmental_type.title: Social Environmental Type
social_environmental_type.description: This field is populated if the ETF's strategy involves providing exposure to a specific social or environmental theme.

clean_energy_type.title: Clean Energy Type
clean_energy_type.description: This field is populated if the ETF has a value of 'Clean Energy' in the 'social_environmental_type' field.

dividend_type.title: Dividend Type
dividend_type.description: This field is populated if the ETF has an intended investment objective of holding dividend-oriented stocks as stated in the prospectus.

regular_dividend_payor_type.title: Regular Dividend Payor Type
regular_dividend_payor_type.description: This field is populated if the ETF has a value of'Dividend - Regular Payors' in the 'dividend_type' field.

quant_strategies_type.title: Quant Strategies Type
quant_strategies_type.description: This field is populated if the ETF has either an index-linked or active strategy that is based on a proprietary quantitative strategy.

other_quant_models.title: Other Quant Models
other_quant_models.description: For ETFs where 'quant_strategies_type' is 'Other Quant Model', this field provides the name of the specific proprietary quant model used as the underlying strategy for the ETF.

hedge_fund_type.title: Hedge Fund Type
hedge_fund_type.description: For ETFs where 'other_asset_types' is 'Hedge Fund Replication', this field provides detail on the type of hedge fund replication strategy.

excludes_financials.title: Excludes Financials
excludes_financials.description: For equity ETFs, identifies those ETFs where the underlying fund holdings will not hold financials stocks, based on the funds intended objective.

excludes_technology.title: Excludes Technology
excludes_technology.description: For equity ETFs, identifies those ETFs where the underlying fund holdings will not hold technology stocks, based on the funds intended objective.

holds_only_nyse_stocks.title: Holds Only Nyse Stocks
holds_only_nyse_stocks.description: If true, the ETF is an equity ETF and holds only stocks listed on NYSE.

holds_only_nasdaq_stocks.title: Holds Only Nasdaq Stocks
holds_only_nasdaq_stocks.description: If true, the ETF is an equity ETF and holds only stocks listed on Nasdaq.

holds_mlp.title: Holds Mlp
holds_mlp.description: If true, the ETF's investment objective explicitly specifies that it holds MLPs as an intended part of its investment strategy.

holds_preferred_stock.title: Holds Preferred Stock
holds_preferred_stock.description: If true, the ETF's investment objective explicitly specifies that it holds preferred stock as an intended part of its investment strategy.

holds_closed_end_funds.title: Holds Closed End Funds
holds_closed_end_funds.description: If true, the ETF's investment objective explicitly specifies that it holds closed end funds as an intended part of its investment strategy.

holds_adr.title: Holds Adr
holds_adr.description: If true, he ETF's investment objective explicitly specifies that it holds American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) as an intended part of its investment strategy.

laddered.title: Laddered
laddered.description: For bond ETFs, this field identifies those ETFs that specifically hold bonds in a laddered structure, where the bonds are scheduled to mature in an annual, sequential structure.

zero_coupon.title: Zero Coupon
zero_coupon.description: For bond ETFs, this field identifies those ETFs that specifically hold zero coupon Treasury Bills.

floating_rate.title: Floating Rate
floating_rate.description: For bond ETFs, this field identifies those ETFs that specifically hold floating rate bonds.

build_america_bonds.title: Build America Bonds
build_america_bonds.description: For municipal bond ETFs, this field identifies those ETFs that specifically hold Build America Bonds.

dynamic_futures_roll.title: Dynamic Futures Roll
dynamic_futures_roll.description: If the product holds futures contracts, this field identifies those products where the roll strategy is dynamic (rather than entirely rules based), so as to minimize roll costs.

currency_hedged.title: Currency Hedged
currency_hedged.description: This field is populated if the ETF's strategy involves hedging currency exposure.

includes_short_exposure.title: Includes Short Exposure
includes_short_exposure.description: This field is populated if the ETF has short exposure in any of its holdings e.g. in a long/short or inverse ETF.

ucits.title: Ucits
ucits.description: If true, the Exchange Traded Product (ETP) is Undertakings for the Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) compliant

registered_countries.title: Registered Countries
registered_countries.description: The list of countries where the ETF is legally registered for sale. This may differ from where the ETF is domiciled or traded, particularly in Europe.

issuer_country.title: Issuer Country
issuer_country.description: 2 letter ISO country code for the country where the issuer is located.

listing_country_code.title: Listing Country Code
listing_country_code.description: 2 letter ISO country code for the country of the primary listing.

listing_region.title: Listing Region
listing_region.description: Geographic region in the country of the primary listing falls.

bond_currency_denomination.title: Bond Currency Denomination
bond_currency_denomination.description: For all bond ETFs, this field provides additional detail on the currency denomination of the underlying securities.

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: Base currency in which NAV is reported.

listing_currency.title: Listing Currency
listing_currency.description: Listing currency of the Exchange Traded Product (ETP) in which it is traded. Reported using the 3-digit ISO currency code.

number_of_holdings.title: Number Of Holdings
number_of_holdings.description: The number of holdings in the ETF.

month_end_assets.title: Month End Assets
month_end_assets.description: Net assets in millions of dollars as of the most recent month end.

net_expense_ratio.title: Net Expense Ratio
net_expense_ratio.description: Gross expense net of Fee Waivers, as a percentage of net assets as published by the ETF issuer.

etf_portfolio_turnover.title: Etf Portfolio Turnover
etf_portfolio_turnover.description: The percentage of positions turned over in the last 12 months.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

reported_currency.title: Reported Currency
reported_currency.description: The currency in which the balance sheet is reported.

cash_and_equivalents.title: Cash And Equivalents
cash_and_equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

restricted_cash.title: Restricted Cash
restricted_cash.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

short_term_investments.title: Short Term Investments
short_term_investments.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

fed_funds_sold.title: Fed Funds Sold
fed_funds_sold.description: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

interest_bearing_deposits_at_other_banks.title: Interest Bearing Deposits At Other Banks
interest_bearing_deposits_at_other_banks.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

time_deposits_placed.title: Time Deposits Placed
time_deposits_placed.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

trading_account_securities.title: Trading Account Securities
trading_account_securities.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

loans_and_leases.title: Loans And Leases
loans_and_leases.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

allowance_for_loan_and_lease_losses.title: Allowance For Loan And Lease Losses
allowance_for_loan_and_lease_losses.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

net_loans_and_leases.title: Net Loans And Leases
net_loans_and_leases.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

loans_held_for_sale.title: Loans Held For Sale
loans_held_for_sale.description: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

accrued_investment_income.title: Accrued Investment Income
accrued_investment_income.description: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

accounts_receivable.title: Accounts Receivable
accounts_receivable.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

customer_and_other_receivables.title: Customer And Other Receivables
customer_and_other_receivables.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

note_receivable.title: Note Receivable
note_receivable.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

nontrade_receivables.title: Nontrade Receivables
nontrade_receivables.description: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

net_inventory.title: Net Inventory
net_inventory.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

prepaid_expenses.title: Prepaid Expenses
prepaid_expenses.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

current_deferred_tax_assets.title: Current Deferred Tax Assets
current_deferred_tax_assets.description: The current portion of the aggregate tax effects as of the balance sheet date of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after deducting the allocated valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, are classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference. An unrecognized tax benefit that is directly related to a position taken in a tax year that results in a net operating loss carryforward is presented as a reduction of the related deferred tax asset.

other_current_assets.title: Other Current Assets
other_current_assets.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

other_current_nonoperating_assets.title: Other Current Nonoperating Assets
other_current_nonoperating_assets.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

total_current_assets.title: Total Current Assets
total_current_assets.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

gross_ppe.title: Gross PPE
gross_ppe.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

accumulated_depreciation.title: Accumulated Depreciation
accumulated_depreciation.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

net_ppe.title: Net PPE
net_ppe.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

net_premises_and_equipment.title: Net Premises And Equipment
net_premises_and_equipment.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

operating_lease_right_of_use_asset.title: Operating Lease Right Of Use Asset
operating_lease_right_of_use_asset.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.title: Finance Lease Right Of Use Asset
finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

long_term_investments.title: Long Term Investments
long_term_investments.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

mortgage_servicing_rights.title: Mortgage Servicing Rights
mortgage_servicing_rights.description: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

deferred_acquisition_cost.title: Deferred Acquisition Cost
deferred_acquisition_cost.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

separate_account_business_assets.title: Separate Account Business Assets
separate_account_business_assets.description: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

noncurrent_note_receivables.title: Noncurrent Note Receivables
noncurrent_note_receivables.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

goodwill.title: Goodwill
goodwill.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

intangible_assets.title: Intangible Assets
intangible_assets.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.title: Noncurrent Deferred Tax Assets
noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.description: The noncurrent portion as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate carrying amount of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after the valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, is classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference.

employee_benefit_assets.title: Employee Benefit Assets
employee_benefit_assets.description: This represents the entire assets recognized in the balance sheet that are associated with the defined benefit plans.

other_noncurrent_assets.title: Other Noncurrent Assets
other_noncurrent_assets.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

other_noncurrent_nonoperating_assets.title: Other Noncurrent Nonoperating Assets
other_noncurrent_nonoperating_assets.description: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

other_noncurrent_assets_excl_ppe.title: Other Noncurrent Assets Excl Ppe
other_noncurrent_assets_excl_ppe.description: Noncurrent assets other than investments and PP&E.

total_noncurrent_assets.title: Total Noncurrent Assets
total_noncurrent_assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

other_assets.title: Other Assets
other_assets.description: Amount of assets classified as other.

total_assets.title: Total Assets
total_assets.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

noninterest_bearing_deposits.title: Noninterest Bearing Deposits
noninterest_bearing_deposits.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

interest_bearing_deposits.title: Interest Bearing Deposits
interest_bearing_deposits.description: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

fed_funds_purchased.title: Fed Funds Purchased
fed_funds_purchased.description: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

short_term_debt.title: Short Term Debt
short_term_debt.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

current_portion_of_long_term_debt.title: Current Portion Of Long Term Debt
current_portion_of_long_term_debt.description: Amount of long-term debt due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

bankers_acceptances.title: Bankers Acceptances
bankers_acceptances.description: Amount of short-term, negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by a financial institution. Bankers acceptances are a bank's promise to pay to the holder of the draft a stated amount on a specified date.

accounts_payable.title: Accounts Payable
accounts_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

accrued_interest_payable.title: Accrued Interest Payable
accrued_interest_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

other_short_term_payables.title: Other Short Term Payables
other_short_term_payables.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

accrued_expenses.title: Accrued Expenses
accrued_expenses.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

customer_deposits.title: Customer Deposits
customer_deposits.description: Carrying amount of liabilities for customer deposits received and held, classified as current. Includes cash received in advance for undelivered goods or services and refundable security deposits.

dividends_payable.title: Dividends Payable
dividends_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

current_deferred_revenue.title: Current Deferred Revenue
current_deferred_revenue.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

current_deferred_tax_liabilities.title: Current Deferred Tax Liabilities
current_deferred_tax_liabilities.description: Represents the current portion of deferred tax liabilities, which result from applying the applicable tax rate to net taxable temporary differences pertaining to each jurisdiction to which the entity is obligated to pay income tax. A current taxable temporary difference is a difference between the tax basis and the carrying amount of a current asset or liability in the financial statements prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. In a classified statement of financial position, an enterprise separates deferred tax liabilities and assets into a current amount and a noncurrent amount. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, is classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference.

current_employee_benefit_liabilities.title: Current Employee Benefit Liabilities
current_employee_benefit_liabilities.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

other_taxes_payable.title: Other Taxes Payable
other_taxes_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

other_current_liabilities.title: Other Current Liabilities
other_current_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

other_current_nonoperating_liabilities.title: Other Current Nonoperating Liabilities
other_current_nonoperating_liabilities.description: Amount of current liabilities from nonoperating activities, classified as other. Includes accrued liabilities and other liabilities not separately disclosed.

operating_lease_liability_current.title: Operating Lease Liability Current
operating_lease_liability_current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

finance_lease_liability_current.title: Finance Lease Liability Current
finance_lease_liability_current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

total_current_liabilities.title: Total Current Liabilities
total_current_liabilities.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

long_term_debt.title: Long Term Debt
long_term_debt.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

capital_lease_obligations.title: Capital Lease Obligations
capital_lease_obligations.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

operating_lease_liability_noncurrent.title: Operating Lease Liability Noncurrent
operating_lease_liability_noncurrent.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

claims_and_claim_expenses.title: Claims And Claim Expenses
claims_and_claim_expenses.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

future_policy_benefits.title: Future Policy Benefits
future_policy_benefits.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

unearned_premiums_credit.title: Unearned Premiums Credit
unearned_premiums_credit.description: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

policyholder_funds.title: Policyholder Funds
policyholder_funds.description: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

participating_policyholder_equity.title: Participating Policyholder Equity
participating_policyholder_equity.description: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

separate_account_business_liabilities.title: Separate Account Business Liabilities
separate_account_business_liabilities.description: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

other_long_term_liabilities.title: Other Long Term Liabilities
other_long_term_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

asset_retirement_and_litigation_obligati.title: Asset Retirement And Litigation Obligation
asset_retirement_and_litigation_obligati.description: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

noncurrent_deferred_revenue.title: Noncurrent Deferred Revenue
noncurrent_deferred_revenue.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabilities.title: Noncurrent Deferred Tax Liabilities
noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabilities.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

noncurrent_employee_benefit_liabilities.title: Noncurrent Employee Benefit Liabilities
noncurrent_employee_benefit_liabilities.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

other_noncurrent_liabilities.title: Other Noncurrent Liabilities
other_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

other_noncurrent_nonoperating_liabilitie.title: Other Noncurrent Nonoperating Liabilities
other_noncurrent_nonoperating_liabilitie.description: Amount of noncurrent liabilities from nonoperating activities, classified as other. Includes deferred income taxes and other liabilities not separately disclosed.

total_noncurrent_liabilities.title: Total Noncurrent Liabilities
total_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

total_liabilities.title: Total Liabilities
total_liabilities.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

commitments_and_contingencies.title: Commitments And Contingencies
commitments_and_contingencies.description: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

temporary_equity.title: Temporary Equity
temporary_equity.description: Carrying amount of the equity component of securities that are redeemable.

temporary_equity_parent.title: Temporary Equity Parent
temporary_equity_parent.description: Carrying amount of temporary equity attributable to parent.

redeemable_noncontrolling_interest.title: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
redeemable_noncontrolling_interest.description: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

redeemable_nci_common.title: Redeemable NCI Common
redeemable_nci_common.description: Equity carrying amount of the common stock component of redeemable NCI.

redeemable_nci_preferred.title: Redeemable NCI Preferred
redeemable_nci_preferred.description: Equity carrying amount of the preferred stock component of redeemable NCI.

redeemable_nci_other.title: Redeemable NCI Other
redeemable_nci_other.description: Equity carrying amount of the other component of redeemable NCI.

total_preferred_equity.title: Total Preferred Equity
total_preferred_equity.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

common_equity.title: Common Equity
common_equity.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

additional_paid_in_capital.title: Additional Paid In Capital
additional_paid_in_capital.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

treasury_stock.title: Treasury Stock
treasury_stock.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

accumulated_other_comprehensive_income.title: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income
accumulated_other_comprehensive_income.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

other_equity.title: Other Equity
other_equity.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

total_common_equity.title: Total Common Equity
total_common_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

total_equity.title: Total Equity
total_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

noncontrolling_interests.title: Noncontrolling Interests
noncontrolling_interests.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

total_equity_and_noncontrolling_interest.title: Total Equity And Noncontrolling Interests
total_equity_and_noncontrolling_interest.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

total_liabilities_and_equity.title: Total Liabilities And Equity
total_liabilities_and_equity.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

period_ending.title: Period Ending
period_ending.description: The end date of the reporting period.

fiscal_period.title: Fiscal Period
fiscal_period.description: The fiscal period of the report.

fiscal_year.title: Fiscal Year
fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

growth_cash_and_equivalents.title: Growth Cash And Equivalents
growth_cash_and_equivalents.description: Growth rate of cash and cash equivalents.

growth_fed_funds_sold.title: Growth Fed Funds Sold
growth_fed_funds_sold.description: Growth rate of federal funds sold.

growth_interest_bearing_deposits_at_othe.title: Growth Interest Bearing Deposits At Other Banks
growth_interest_bearing_deposits_at_othe.description: Growth rate of interest-bearing deposits at other banks.

growth_time_deposits_placed.title: Growth Time Deposits Placed
growth_time_deposits_placed.description: Growth rate of time deposits placed.

growth_trading_account_securities.title: Growth Trading Account Securities
growth_trading_account_securities.description: Growth rate of trading account securities.

growth_loans_and_leases.title: Growth Loans And Leases
growth_loans_and_leases.description: Growth rate of loans and leases.

growth_allowance_for_loan_and_lease_loss.title: Growth Allowance For Loan And Lease Losses
growth_allowance_for_loan_and_lease_loss.description: Growth rate of allowance for loan and lease losses.

growth_net_loans_and_leases.title: Growth Net Loans And Leases
growth_net_loans_and_leases.description: Growth rate of net loans and leases.

growth_loans_held_for_sale.title: Growth Loans Held For Sale
growth_loans_held_for_sale.description: Growth rate of loans held for sale.

growth_accrued_investment_income.title: Growth Accrued Investment Income
growth_accrued_investment_income.description: Growth rate of accrued investment income.

growth_customer_and_other_receivables.title: Growth Customer And Other Receivables
growth_customer_and_other_receivables.description: Growth rate of customer and other receivables.

growth_current_deferred_tax_assets.title: Growth Current Deferred Tax Assets
growth_current_deferred_tax_assets.description: Growth rate of current deferred tax assets.

growth_other_current_assets.title: Growth Other Current Assets
growth_other_current_assets.description: Growth rate of other current assets.

growth_other_current_nonoperating_assets.title: Growth Other Current Nonoperating Assets
growth_other_current_nonoperating_assets.description: Growth rate of other current nonoperating assets.

growth_total_current_assets.title: Growth Total Current Assets
growth_total_current_assets.description: Growth rate of total current assets.

growth_gross_ppe.title: Growth Gross Ppe
growth_gross_ppe.description: Growth rate of gross property, plant, and equipment.

growth_net_ppe.title: Growth Net Ppe
growth_net_ppe.description: Growth rate of net property, plant, and equipment.

growth_net_premises_and_equipment.title: Growth Net Premises And Equipment
growth_net_premises_and_equipment.description: Growth rate of net premises and equipment.

growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.title: Growth Operating Lease Right Of Use Asset
growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.description: Growth rate of operating lease right-of-use asset.

growth_finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.title: Growth Finance Lease Right Of Use Asset
growth_finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.description: Growth rate of finance lease right-of-use asset.

growth_mortgage_servicing_rights.title: Growth Mortgage Servicing Rights
growth_mortgage_servicing_rights.description: Growth rate of mortgage servicing rights.

growth_deferred_acquisition_cost.title: Growth Deferred Acquisition Cost
growth_deferred_acquisition_cost.description: Growth rate of deferred acquisition cost.

growth_separate_account_business_assets.title: Growth Separate Account Business Assets
growth_separate_account_business_assets.description: Growth rate of separate account business assets.

growth_noncurrent_note_receivables.title: Growth Noncurrent Note Receivables
growth_noncurrent_note_receivables.description: Growth rate of noncurrent note receivables.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.title: Growth Noncurrent Deferred Tax Assets
growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.description: Growth rate of noncurrent deferred tax assets.

growth_employee_benefit_assets.title: Growth Employee Benefit Assets
growth_employee_benefit_assets.description: Growth rate of employee benefit assets.

growth_other_noncurrent_assets.title: Growth Other Noncurrent Assets
growth_other_noncurrent_assets.description: Growth rate of other noncurrent assets.

growth_other_noncurrent_nonoperating_ass.title: Growth Other Noncurrent Nonoperating Assets
growth_other_noncurrent_nonoperating_ass.description: Growth rate of other noncurrent nonoperating assets.

growth_other_noncurrent_assets_excl_ppe.title: Growth Other Noncurrent Assets Excl Ppe
growth_other_noncurrent_assets_excl_ppe.description: Growth rate of other noncurrent assets excluding PPE.

growth_total_noncurrent_assets.title: Growth Total Noncurrent Assets
growth_total_noncurrent_assets.description: Growth rate of total noncurrent assets.

growth_fed_funds_purchased.title: Growth Fed Funds Purchased
growth_fed_funds_purchased.description: Growth rate of federal funds purchased.

growth_current_portion_of_long_term_debt.title: Growth Current Portion Of Long Term Debt
growth_current_portion_of_long_term_debt.description: Growth rate of current portion of long-term debt.

growth_accrued_interest_payable.title: Growth Accrued Interest Payable
growth_accrued_interest_payable.description: Growth rate of accrued interest payable.

growth_other_short_term_payables.title: Growth Other Short Term Payables
growth_other_short_term_payables.description: Growth rate of other short-term payables.

growth_current_deferred_revenue.title: Growth Current Deferred Revenue
growth_current_deferred_revenue.description: Growth rate of current deferred revenue.

growth_current_deferred_tax_liabilities.title: Growth Current Deferred Tax Liabilities
growth_current_deferred_tax_liabilities.description: Growth rate of current deferred tax liabilities.

growth_current_employee_benefit_liabilit.title: Growth Current Employee Benefit Liabilities
growth_current_employee_benefit_liabilit.description: Growth rate of current employee benefit liabilities.

growth_other_taxes_payable.title: Growth Other Taxes Payable
growth_other_taxes_payable.description: Growth rate of other taxes payable.

growth_other_current_liabilities.title: Growth Other Current Liabilities
growth_other_current_liabilities.description: Growth rate of other current liabilities.

growth_other_current_nonoperating_liabil.title: Growth Other Current Nonoperating Liabilities
growth_other_current_nonoperating_liabil.description: Growth rate of other current nonoperating liabilities.

growth_operating_lease_liability_current.title: Growth Operating Lease Liability Current
growth_operating_lease_liability_current.description: Growth rate of current operating lease liability.

growth_finance_lease_liability_current.title: Growth Finance Lease Liability Current
growth_finance_lease_liability_current.description: Growth rate of current finance lease liability.

growth_total_current_liabilities.title: Growth Total Current Liabilities
growth_total_current_liabilities.description: Growth rate of total current liabilities.

growth_capital_lease_obligations.title: Growth Capital Lease Obligations
growth_capital_lease_obligations.description: Growth rate of capital lease obligations.

growth_operating_lease_liability_noncurr.title: Growth Operating Lease Liability Noncurrent
growth_operating_lease_liability_noncurr.description: Growth rate of noncurrent operating lease liability.

growth_claims_and_claim_expenses.title: Growth Claims And Claim Expenses
growth_claims_and_claim_expenses.description: Growth rate of claims and claim expenses.

growth_future_policy_benefits.title: Growth Future Policy Benefits
growth_future_policy_benefits.description: Growth rate of future policy benefits.

growth_unearned_premiums_credit.title: Growth Unearned Premiums Credit
growth_unearned_premiums_credit.description: Growth rate of unearned premiums credit.

growth_participating_policyholder_equity.title: Growth Participating Policyholder Equity
growth_participating_policyholder_equity.description: Growth rate of participating policyholder equity.

growth_separate_account_business_liabili.title: Growth Separate Account Business Liabilities
growth_separate_account_business_liabili.description: Growth rate of separate account business liabilities.

growth_other_long_term_liabilities.title: Growth Other Long Term Liabilities
growth_other_long_term_liabilities.description: Growth rate of other long-term liabilities.

growth_asset_retirement_and_litigation_o.title: Growth Asset Retirement And Litigation Obligation
growth_asset_retirement_and_litigation_o.description: Growth rate of asset retirement and litigation obligation.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_revenue.title: Growth Noncurrent Deferred Revenue
growth_noncurrent_deferred_revenue.description: Growth rate of noncurrent deferred revenue.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabiliti.title: Growth Noncurrent Deferred Tax Liabilities
growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabiliti.description: Growth rate of noncurrent deferred tax liabilities.

growth_noncurrent_employee_benefit_liabi.title: Growth Noncurrent Employee Benefit Liabilities
growth_noncurrent_employee_benefit_liabi.description: Growth rate of noncurrent employee benefit liabilities.

growth_other_noncurrent_liabilities.title: Growth Other Noncurrent Liabilities
growth_other_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Growth rate of other noncurrent liabilities.

growth_other_noncurrent_nonoperating_lia.title: Growth Other Noncurrent Nonoperating Liabilities
growth_other_noncurrent_nonoperating_lia.description: Growth rate of other noncurrent nonoperating liabilities.

growth_total_noncurrent_liabilities.title: Growth Total Noncurrent Liabilities
growth_total_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Growth rate of total noncurrent liabilities.

growth_commitments_and_contingencies.title: Growth Commitments And Contingencies
growth_commitments_and_contingencies.description: Growth rate of commitments and contingencies.

growth_temporary_equity_parent.title: Growth Temporary Equity Parent
growth_temporary_equity_parent.description: Growth rate of temporary equity attributable to parent.

growth_redeemable_noncontrolling_interes.title: Growth Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
growth_redeemable_noncontrolling_interes.description: Growth rate of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

growth_redeemable_nci_common.title: Growth Redeemable Nci Common
growth_redeemable_nci_common.description: Growth rate of redeemable NCI common.

growth_redeemable_nci_preferred.title: Growth Redeemable Nci Preferred
growth_redeemable_nci_preferred.description: Growth rate of redeemable NCI preferred.

growth_redeemable_nci_other.title: Growth Redeemable Nci Other
growth_redeemable_nci_other.description: Growth rate of redeemable NCI other.

growth_total_preferred_equity.title: Growth Total Preferred Equity
growth_total_preferred_equity.description: Growth rate of total preferred equity.

growth_additional_paid_in_capital.title: Growth Additional Paid In Capital
growth_additional_paid_in_capital.description: Growth rate of additional paid-in capital.

growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.title: Growth Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income
growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.description: Growth rate of accumulated other comprehensive income.

growth_total_common_equity.title: Growth Total Common Equity
growth_total_common_equity.description: Growth rate of total common equity.

growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.title: Growth Total Equity And Noncontrolling Interests
growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.description: Growth rate of total equity and noncontrolling interests.

growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.title: Growth Total Liabilities And Equity
growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.description: Growth rate of total liabilities and equity.

period_ending.title: Period Ending
period_ending.description: The end date of the reporting period.

fiscal_period.title: Fiscal Period
fiscal_period.description: The fiscal period of the report.

fiscal_year.title: Fiscal Year
fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

reported_currency.title: Reported Currency
reported_currency.description: The currency in which the cash flow statement is reported.

net_income.title: Net Income
net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

net_income_discontinued.title: Net Income Discontinued
net_income_discontinued.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

net_income_continuing.title: Net Income Continuing
net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

provision_for_loan_losses.title: Provision For Loan Losses
provision_for_loan_losses.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

depreciation_expense.title: Depreciation Expense
depreciation_expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

amortization_expense.title: Amortization Expense
amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

depreciation_and_amortization.title: Depreciation And Amortization
depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

stock_based_compensation.title: Stock Based Compensation
stock_based_compensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

deferred_income_tax.title: Deferred Income Tax
deferred_income_tax.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

gain_loss_on_investments.title: Gain Loss On Investments
gain_loss_on_investments.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

gain_loss_on_sale_of_assets.title: Gain Loss On Sale Of Assets
gain_loss_on_sale_of_assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

income_loss_from_equity_method_investmen.title: Income Loss From Equity Method Investments
income_loss_from_equity_method_investmen.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

asset_impairment_charges.title: Asset Impairment Charges
asset_impairment_charges.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.title: Noncash Adjustments To Net Income
noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

other_operating_activities.title: Other Operating Activities
other_operating_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

change_in_insurance_reserves.title: Change In Insurance Reserves
change_in_insurance_reserves.description: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

change_in_accounts_receivable.title: Change In Accounts Receivable
change_in_accounts_receivable.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

change_in_nontrade_receivables.title: Change In Nontrade Receivables
change_in_nontrade_receivables.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

change_in_inventories.title: Change In Inventories
change_in_inventories.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

change_in_accounts_payable.title: Change In Accounts Payable
change_in_accounts_payable.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

change_in_other_operating_assets_and_lia.title: Change In Other Operating Assets And Liabilities
change_in_other_operating_assets_and_lia.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

increase_decrease_in_operating_capital.title: Increase Decrease In Operating Capital
increase_decrease_in_operating_capital.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

net_cash_from_continuing_operating_activ.title: Net Cash From Continuing Operating Activities
net_cash_from_continuing_operating_activ.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

net_cash_from_discontinued_operating_act.title: Net Cash From Discontinued Operating Activities
net_cash_from_discontinued_operating_act.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

net_cash_from_operating_activities.title: Net Cash From Operating Activities
net_cash_from_operating_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

purchase_of_plant_property_and_equipment.title: Purchase Of Plant Property And Equipment
purchase_of_plant_property_and_equipment.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

acquisitions.title: Acquisitions
acquisitions.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

purchase_of_investments.title: Purchase Of Investments
purchase_of_investments.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

purchase_of_held_to_maturity_investments.title: Purchase Of Held To Maturity Investments
purchase_of_held_to_maturity_investments.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

sale_of_plant_property_and_equipment.title: Sale Of Plant Property And Equipment
sale_of_plant_property_and_equipment.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

sale_of_productive_assets.title: Sale Of Productive Assets
sale_of_productive_assets.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

divestitures.title: Divestitures
divestitures.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

sale_of_investments.title: Sale Of Investments
sale_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

maturity_of_investments.title: Maturity Of Investments
maturity_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

net_increase_in_fed_funds_sold.title: Net Increase In Fed Funds Sold
net_increase_in_fed_funds_sold.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

loans_held_for_sale_net.title: Loans Held For Sale Net
loans_held_for_sale_net.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

other_investing_activities_net.title: Other Investing Activities Net
other_investing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

net_cash_from_continuing_investing_activ.title: Net Cash From Continuing Investing Activities
net_cash_from_continuing_investing_activ.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

net_cash_from_discontinued_investing_act.title: Net Cash From Discontinued Investing Activities
net_cash_from_discontinued_investing_act.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

net_cash_from_investing_activities.title: Net Cash From Investing Activities
net_cash_from_investing_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

repayment_of_debt.title: Repayment Of Debt
repayment_of_debt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

repurchase_of_preferred_equity.title: Repurchase Of Preferred Equity
repurchase_of_preferred_equity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

repurchase_of_common_equity.title: Repurchase Of Common Equity
repurchase_of_common_equity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

payment_of_dividends.title: Payment Of Dividends
payment_of_dividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

issuance_of_debt.title: Issuance Of Debt
issuance_of_debt.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

issuance_of_preferred_equity.title: Issuance Of Preferred Equity
issuance_of_preferred_equity.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

issuance_of_common_equity.title: Issuance Of Common Equity
issuance_of_common_equity.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

net_change_in_deposits.title: Net Change In Deposits
net_change_in_deposits.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

short_term_debt_net.title: Short Term Debt Net
short_term_debt_net.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tax_withholding_share_based_compensation.title: Tax Withholding Share Based Compensation
tax_withholding_share_based_compensation.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

other_financing_activities_net.title: Other Financing Activities Net
other_financing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

net_cash_from_continuing_financing_activ.title: Net Cash From Continuing Financing Activities
net_cash_from_continuing_financing_activ.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

net_cash_from_discontinued_financing_act.title: Net Cash From Discontinued Financing Activities
net_cash_from_discontinued_financing_act.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

net_cash_from_financing_activities.title: Net Cash From Financing Activities
net_cash_from_financing_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

effect_of_exchange_rate_changes.title: Effect Of Exchange Rate Changes
effect_of_exchange_rate_changes.description: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances held in foreign currencies.

net_cash_from_discontinued_operations.title: Net Cash From Discontinued Operations
